text.what: New Zealand's largest region by a distance, known abroad for sauvignon blanc and holding the country's biggest pinot noir planting almost as a side effect — still wine on the clay of the Southern Valleys, sparkling base on the Wairau gravels.

kin.as: Planted at scale here, and rarely the headline.
The region that gets the pinot attention.
